paragraphs: Chavivi. Rav called Rabbi Chiyya, his uncle, Chavivi: Haumanin 76b; Bava Batra 46a; Chullin 32a; Eruvin 12, end of side b. It means “my father’s brother”: Jerusalem Targum,“Aaron’s uncle,”chaviva de-Aharon;“his aunt,”chavivato.
